statement: A tenant document may bind an app's permission policy only scoped to that app; the binding resolves the policy from that app's document in the same view, and anywhere else the document does not compile. A request in that app reads the app's document whenever its tenant's document binds one of the app's permission policies to Anyone or to a principal, roles or not.
guards: document:PolicyDocumentCompilerTest#permission policies live in their app's document
document:PolicyDocumentCompilerTest#a tenant document names the apps its bindings of their permissions need
engine:EngineTest#a tenant binding an app's permission policy without roles needs the app's document
